description: Gold dataset for blvd detail parser (parseBlvdDetail). Cases cover normal detail pages, accessibility feature extraction, and edge cases. Engine specs are NOT mapped to fuelType.
evidenceRef: https://www.blvd.com/wheelchair-vans-for-sale — verified 2026-06-30 against live detail page structure

cases.description: Normal detail page with fold-out ramp and full specs

input.descriptionText: Rear Entry, Manual, Fold Out ramp or lift is fully operational. 14 inch floor lowering. This is a beautiful van with hand controls installed.
input.dealerAddressText:
3575 W Cheyenne Ave
North Las Vegas, NV 89032

cases.notes: Engine spec must NOT be mapped to fuelType (blvd-specific rule). floor lowering detected in description text. has_lift is included because 'lift' appears in 'ramp or lift is' — the parser matches \blift\b in description text unconditionally. This is a known false-positive pattern; a future refinement could exclude this phrasing.

cases.description: In-floor ramp with power ramp feature

input.descriptionText: In-Floor Ramp is fully operational. Power ramp system included. Lowered floor.

cases.notes: in_floor ramp detected. power_ramp and lowered_floor in wavFeatures. No floor lowering inches (text says 'lowered floor' without a number).

cases.description: Sold vehicle sets saleStatus to sold

input.descriptionText: Rear Entry Fold Out ramp. Great van.

cases.notes: Status banner 'Sold' must map to saleStatus 'sold'. Empty gallery returns empty images array. No phone returns null.

cases.description: Description not found (descriptionFound: false) yields null description
cases.notes: When descriptionFound is false the description field and all description-derived fields (rampType, wavFeatures, floorLoweringInches) must not be populated from the empty text. rampType defaults to 'unknown', wavFeatures to [].

cases.description: Transfer seat and automatic door in description

input.descriptionText: Side entry conversion with transfer seat system. Automatic door installed. Fold-in ramp.

cases.notes: Multiple WAV features extracted from description. fold_in ramp detected.
